title: Attention NN reaches all six positions
summary: Kicker attention support lands (801b61a), completing the six-position attention rollout begun with DST — every position now trains the game-history attention variant alongside Ridge, the dense NN, and LightGBM.

title: Full-fleet retrain on the Batch Spot fan-out
summary: Six-position benchmark refresh on the parallel AWS Batch Spot path: mean Attention-NN MAE across positions improves 5.154 → 4.626 with aggregate R² turning solidly positive.

title: Feature + loss-head tuning wave
summary: Accumulated feature-engineering and per-position loss-head tuning land in a full retrain: mean Attention-NN MAE 4.626 → 4.497.

title: Stacked-seed tuning round
summary: Hyperparameters re-tuned under the N=24 stacked-seed regime (single-seed MAE is noise) and shipped through a full retrain: mean Attention-NN MAE 4.497 → 4.370, the best fleet-wide reading to date.

title: Current production baseline
summary: Latest full six-position retrain; mean Attention-NN MAE holds at 4.383 (within seed noise of the 2026-06-11 best) on the held-out test season.
